completed_deductions: With an actual nice sliced E, Jacobian square nonzero, a supplied constant good direction and nonlinear ternary velocity cone, the three transverse velocities are coprime homogeneous binary forms of actual invariant polynomials p,q. The pair has gcd one. Their ideal powers satisfy I^(2e-1) subset L subset I^e in both B and A, and their zero sets coincide.

The descended pair is also Q-invariant. Original slice contraction gives Tp,Tq,TP4 in I_A^e and intrinsic delta(A) subset I_A^(2e-1), with delta(I_A^r) subset I_A^(r+2e-1). A proper parameter ideal requires algebraically independent p,q. No parameter is assumed to be an ambient coordinate.

The transverse velocity ideal is an actual cylinder in the good coordinate, including nilpotents. Its intrinsic quotient is explicitly the same quotient of the three-variable base ring. The full nonreduced first-jet matrix satisfies N(w)=N0-w v^(-1)N0^2, and JacQ=-v^(-1)N0^2 modulo that ideal.

For a flat S-algebra and a derivation nonzero on every whole scheme fiber, {c in S:cD(A) subset LA}=L for every base ideal L. The inherited primitive-fiber theorem applies, so raw delta=hD image order is equivalent to exact base-ideal membership of h, without assuming D free.

For every m>=2 an actual two-shear coordinate pair has proper ideal, T-derivatives in its m-th power, and no nonconstant polynomial in C[p,q] killed by any nonzero constant partial. Nevertheless every derivation killing that pair and square-killing the four original coordinates is zero. This rules out a stationarity-plus-omission shortcut and its exact nice-action realization, not cancellation.

Neither extra hypothesis is proved for every action. The Chamberland inverse control is exactly the old conic seed after a constant change.
